Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 130. Category: technique. Rank 4.

Rank 4 melee technique
Ki Cost: 60 ki
Casting Time: 1 action
Range: Melee
Chargeable?: No
Duration: Instantaneous
Coat your arm in the visage of a dragon or similar
beast before tearing apart a targets body and soul. Make
a combo attack rolls dealing your unarmed strike
damage die + 4d12 damage on a hit. This damage
affects HP and Ki.
